command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0048/fixture.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Twenty-eight fixed-base SIB instructions, one per 0.19.0 row. Instructions 1-8 are the word rows: load/store, %rsp and %r12, disp8 (content 8) and disp32 (content 128); the %r12 form is one byte longer because it adds REX.B. Instructions 9-16 are the REX-less low-byte rows, 17-20 the high-byte rows (%rsp only, since movb %ah, 8(%r12) has no encoding), and 21-28 the template-40 rows. Every row spends the SIB byte 24 (base 100, index 100) and the displacement lands one byte later than on the corresponding -base-disp row: bit 32/40 on the word rows, 24/32 on the byte rows, and 32 on the 40 rows. input_sha256 is fixture.asm (the source above); output_sha256 is the 178-byte .text.
